diagnosis: The scenario fails the Weak Arm gate because checks C2, C4, and C6 are being satisfied by the model using generic values that match the target facts without actually accessing them. Specifically, the model is defaulting to '30' for alternate_resin_percentage (linked to PF1/C2) and '600' for production_quantity (linked to PF2/C4), likely due to common manufacturing heuristics or pattern-matching, even though these specific values were never provided in the shared context.

C2.why: The materials plan changes from an unspecified alternate-material run to exactly 30% alternate resin and exactly 4 hours of drying at 80 degrees Celsius, with a material-trial record.

C4.why: The approved customer deviation changes the run limit to exactly 600 housings, requires exactly 12 inspected first-off units and serialized traceability, and adds a customer-deviation record.

C6.why: The approved customer deviation changes the run limit to exactly 600 housings, requires exactly 12 inspected first-off units and serialized traceability, and adds a customer-deviation record.

fix_instructions: Tighten checks C2, C4, and C6 by requiring more precise or non-standard numeric values that cannot be guessed via common heuristics.
